title: Valkyries Win WNBA Title in Only Their Second Season
summary:
The Golden State Valkyries beat the Atlanta Dream 68-63 in a thrilling Game 7 on October 31, 2026, to win their first WNBA championship. They made history as the first WNBA expansion team to win a title in just their second season.

An expansion team is a brand new team added to a league. The San Francisco-based Valkyries joined the WNBA as its 13th team in 2025 and won 23 games in their first season, more than any other expansion team.

Down by six at halftime at Chase Center, the Valkyries came back. Gabby Williams scored 28 points, a WNBA postseason record for points in a half, and hit a key late three-pointer to earn the Finals MVP award.
why_it_matters: A new team winning so fast shows that even beginners can reach the top with teamwork and practice.
